descriptions.inProgress: Due to being tricked by Master Goblin, I wound up giving the Red Marble to Do Gong, poisoning him in the process. This isn't true... how can he lie to me? I better go back to see Master Goblin and ask him what's up!
descriptions.completed: Master Goblin offered to give me an #bantidote marble#k if I manage to answer all three of questions... but the true answers were NOWHERE to be found. He NEVER meant to give me the antidote!! What should I do? I better go see Do Gong now.
